member.name: T:Syncfusion.Server.Viewer.Middlewares.EmbedTokenMiddleware
member.summary: Extracts and validates embed_user_token from query string or Authorization header for cross-origin iframe private reports. Sets a flag in HttpContext.Items so that CustomAuthorizeAttribute and downstream code can recognize token-authenticated requests without depending on cookies (which don't work in cross-origin iframe scenarios).

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Server.Viewer.Middlewares.PublicReportAuthBypassMiddleware
member.summary: Middleware to bypass cookie authentication for public report requests. CustomAuthorizeAttribute checks the Items["IsPublicReportRequest"] flag FIRST (before querying ServerPrincipal) and allows the request without touching any real-user data, so downstream code never receives a broken user context.
